text:
jordan: Follow-up from today's authz postmortem. Capturing owners + due dates. High-level causes: token parsing edge-case, analytics role drift, audit-ingest gaps, secrets propagation failures to staging. Keeping it short so we can close the loop.

jordan: Remediations (brief):
1) Harden token parsing + add regression tests -> @mira -> 48h
2) Role-owner registry + weekly diff job -> @devon -> 5d
3) Audit-ingest alert + replay dry-run -> @ops-ledger -> 48h
4) Secrets propagation reconcilier + health endpoint -> @ops-ledger -> 72h

mira: I'll take token parsing. Plan: pin jwt-lib, coerce exp -> int, add unit + e2e, then canary. Will include failing payload in PR.

jordan: please paste a 1-line accept with epoch due ts so I can create reminders.

mira: :thumbsup: accept  due 1999998640 (48h).

devon: I'll own role registry. I'll generate role->owner CSV, submit PR to infra, and add a weekly diff job that reports drift. Due 2000431200 (5d).

ops-ledger: For audit ingest I'll add alert when audit.ingest.latency > 30m, then run a replay dry-run with counts. Secrets reconciler: rolling reconcile, expose GET /secrets/reconcile/status. Due: audit 1999998640 (48h), secrets 1999999800 (72h).

jordan: Two cross-team asks: (a) add owners to the remediation tracker spreadsheet and link it; (b) schedule a monthly pattern review for token+perm regressions  we've seen similar clusters across 4 incidents in the last year.

devon: I'll add the CSV to the tracker and enable the monthly pattern report (tokens, perms, secrets errors).

sec-bot: Reminder rule created: owners will get T-24h + T-4h pings for accepted items. Weekly digest for tag "authz" enabled. Use `/remind` to adjust. :robot_face:

mira: note for PR: failing case was float exp -> comparisons did `==`. Will include snippet: `exp_ts = int(float(payload["exp"]))\nif now >= exp_ts: deny()`

ops-ledger: I'll post dry-run counts and reconciler health output in this thread before applying changes.

jordan: OK. Please react with :thumbsup: here and paste the one-line accept if not done. I'll close once all owners acknowledged and tracker is updated.

mira: :thumbsup: confirmed.

devon: :thumbsup: confirmed.

ops-ledger: :thumbsup: confirmed.

jordan: Thanks all. Reopen if blockers.
